day_shape: 54 items: IDF confirms killing Hamas's Northern Gaza Brigade commander Izz al-Din al-Bik with Katz threatening October 7 planners abroad, Netanyahu visit to UAE draws Iranian condemnation, IRGC issues 26-page letter to US voters, Iran awaits US reply on Hormuz proposal as rial passes 2.5m/dollar; nothing from UK Parliament, State Dept, OFAC or IAEA.

threads.label: IDF kills Hamas Northern Gaza Brigade commander
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed killing Izz al-Din al-Bik, commander of Hamas's Northern Gaza Brigade, in an overnight strike in Gaza City. Defence Minister Israel Katz said Hamas leaders abroad who took part in the October 7, 2023 attack remain targets, and sirens later sounded in Nahal Oz.

threads.label: Netanyahu Abu Dhabi visit and regional coalition
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned Netanyahu's visit to the UAE and warned of consequences, per IRIB, while Defa Press claimed Hebrew sources reported a secret Abu Dhabi meeting of Arab and Israeli officials on an anti-Iran coalition. IRIB also quoted Qatar's prime minister calling Iran a permanent neighbour and Netanyahu a war criminal.

threads.label: Hormuz proposal and IRGC letter to Americans
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran is awaiting a US response to its Strait of Hormuz reopening proposal as the rial fell past 2.5 million to the dollar, and covered a 26-page IRGC letter to US scholars, students and media urging Americans to vote out their leaders. Defa Press quoted SNSC secretary Rezaei saying Iran's conditions were communicated but 'Trump is incapable of decision-making'.

threads.label: Sacred Defence Week messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published messages marking Sacred Defence Week and the anniversary of Hassan Nasrallah's death, praising seven months of street presence and eulogising the Hezbollah leader. IRIB and Defa Press ran parallel content on Quds Force commander Mosajedi calling the resistance a 'global power', National Defence University honours, and Army spokesman Akraminia's Hormuz remarks.

threads.label: Iraq coalition withdrawal and Shia militia posture
threads.summary: Defa Press reported Iraqi Defence Ministry spokesman Brigadier Yahya Rasul told al-Jazeera that no US-led coalition forces remain on Iraqi soil, and quoted Nujaba's Sheikh Ali al-Asadi criticising Baghdad's decision to bar Iranian aircraft as 'surrender to American bullying'. The Sayyid al-Shuhada brigades' spokesman Sheikh Kadhim al-Fartousi said resistance weapons would not be handed over.
